founder_paragraph_2: Today, that same broadcast instinct sits behind every Birdcast session: when to hold a shot, when to cut, when to let silence breathe, and how to make the whole production feel intentional.

faq_description: Answers to the most common questions about recording, production, delivery and bookings at Birdcast.
faq_1_question: What Makes Birdcast Podcast Studio Unique?
faq_1_answer_1: Birdcast isn’t just a podcast studio; it’s a creative haven for passionate storytellers. With a team that genuinely loves crafting amazing content, we’re here to make your vision come to life.
faq_1_answer_2: Our founder, Baligh, brings 28 years of expertise from working with some of the UK’s top broadcasters, ensuring every project benefits from a wealth of experience in high-quality production.
faq_1_answer_3: What truly sets us apart is the seamless experience we offer. From brainstorming unique ideas to recording and editing, our talented team takes care of everything.
faq_1_answer_4: Equipped with the same high-end gear used by Netflix and the world’s top podcasts, we ensure your content has unmatched quality.
faq_1_answer_5: The studio itself is designed to inspire creativity, with multiple customizable sets that can reflect your personal style and bring your vision to life.
faq_1_answer_6: And when it comes to delivery, we’re faster than anyone else. You’ll have your polished content in hand within just 24 hours. Birdcast is where passion meets professionalism, turning your ideas into extraordinary content.
faq_2_answer: Live Mix is the magic of real-time editing. Instead of cutting cameras in post-production, we switch angles live as the podcast is being recorded, just like a live TV interview. This means that once your session ends, you have a fully cut show, needing only color grading, audio sync and small adjustments. Fast, seamless and production-ready.
faq_3_question: Can I View The Studio Before Booking?
faq_3_answer: Yes, absolutely. You’re welcome to visit and explore the studio before making your booking.
faq_4_question: I Don’t Have Any Experience In Podcast Or Content Creation, Is It For Me?
faq_4_answer: Yes, Birdcast is perfect for beginners and professionals alike. Our friendly team will guide you through every step, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience.
faq_5_question: What Equipment Is Available At Birdcast Podcast Studio?
faq_5_answer_1: At Birdcast Podcast Studio, we offer top-of-the-line equipment to ensure your podcast looks and sounds incredible.
faq_5_point_1: 4 Blackmagic 4K Studio Cameras — renowned for exceptional image quality and reliability, trusted by leading productions including Netflix.
faq_5_point_2: Shure SM7B Microphones — the industry standard for professional podcasts, used by the best podcasts in the world for unmatched audio clarity.
faq_5_point_3: Teleprompter — for seamless delivery and on-camera confidence.
faq_5_point_4: Professional Lighting Setup — designed to bring cinematic quality to your podcast visuals.
faq_5_answer_2: When you record at Birdcast, you're working with the same caliber of equipment used by world-class creators and entertainment giants. Your podcast deserves nothing less.
faq_6_question: How Will I Receive My Content?
faq_6_answer_1: You will receive your content through Google Drive. Once it’s ready, we’ll share a secure link so you can easily download and manage your files.
faq_6_answer_2: Please note: all delivered files must be downloaded within 7 days of delivery. After this period, the files may be permanently deleted from our system, and we cannot guarantee re-delivery.
faq_7_question: How Long Will It Take To Receive My Content?
faq_7_answer: We pride ourselves on speed and efficiency. Your finalized content will be ready within 24–72 hours of your session.
faq_8_answer: We’re open every day of the week from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM, making it convenient to fit into your schedule.
faq_9_question: How Do I Make A Booking?
faq_9_answer: Booking is simple. Choose your preferred day and time slot online.
faq_10_question: Can I Change Or Cancel My Booking?
faq_10_answer: You can modify or cancel your booking; however, changes made 48 hours before your session will result in a 50% charge. If you cancel or amend 24 hours before your session, the full booking fee will apply.
